tools.name: make_floor_plan
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a floor plan, room layout or apartment plan drawn to scale from room sizes, for example "draw a floor plan: living 5x4 m, kitchen 3x4 m next to it" or "plan of my house in feet". Takes rooms as rectangles (width east-west, length north-south) in metres or feet and inches

tools.name: check_floor_plan
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to check a room layout before drawing it, or asks why a floor plan was refused, for example "do these rooms overlap?" or "what is the total area of these rooms?".
